newsitem.title: USA: Lexington acquires property for $7.7 mln.
newsitem.headline: Lexington acquires property for $7.7 mln.

text.p: Lexington Corp Properties Inc said on Friday that it had aquired a two-story, 65,755 square foot office and development facility in Rancho Bernardo, Calif., for $7.7 million.

Lexington said it acquired the property with the proceeds from the sale of 625,000 shares of preferred stock after announcing a $25 million senior cumulative convertible preferred stock placement with Five Arrows Realty Securities L.L.C.
Current annual net rent on the building is $736,872 and will increase by 2.5 percent to $755,294 on June 1, the company said, and by about 5 percent every two years thereafter.
The average annual net rent payable during the remaining lease term is about $860,000, or 11.1 percent of the purchase price, Lexington Corp said.
Lexington Corporate Properties Inc is a self-managed real estate investment trust that owns a 6.1 million square foot portfolio.
